summary: Final checkpoint: 10k steps (scored under amendment A3). Over all 32 held-out clips the median hand error is 24 px for the trained model vs 112 px for the base model; it beats the base on 31 of 32 clips.

items.prompt: the potato masher ends up lifted in the left hand.

items.prompt: the red spatula ends up turned in the right hand.
items.note: 8.4 px vs base 65.9 px. The spatula is held by the right hand, mostly out of frame; the visible left hand follows its target closely.
